title: Content beat assembly + teacher critique
description: Produce narrative, systems, and generated content beats in declared order, concatenate them without merging, and critique the assembled sequence as a player would meet it.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-game-02
  title: Content beat assembly + teacher critique
  description: Produce narrative, systems, and generated content beats in declared order, concatenate
    them without merging, and critique the assembled sequence as a player would meet it.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Ship a content sequence whose beats were assembled in play order, critiqued as a whole for
    continuity, and gated on state consistency before it goes into the build.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Content brief and existing state
      summary: Content brief and existing state
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - arc_outline
              - world_state
              - systems_context
              - target_length
            properties:
              arc_outline: {}
              world_state: {}
              systems_context: {}
              target_length: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: n-scope
      kind: transform
      name: Select the segments to produce
      summary: select the beats to produce, in play order
      config:
        operation: select
        expression: select the beats to produce, in play order
    - id: n-segment1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: game-04
      name: Narrative beats and choice consequences
      summary: 'Segment 1: narrative beats and choice consequences.'
      role: Narrative designer building branching story structure that stays coherent under player choice.
      prompt: You are a Narrative Designer. You build branching structure where each choice has a consequence
        the player can perceive, and you track state so a later scene never contradicts an earlier choice.
        You flag branches that converge in a way that erases a decision, because a choice the world forgets
        teaches players their choices do not matter.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - writing-editing
          - domain-analysis
          - design-review
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-segment2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: game-01
      name: Encounter and systems beats
      summary: 'Segment 2: encounter and systems beats.'
      role: Systems designer building mechanics, economies, and progression that hold up under play.
      prompt: You are a Game Systems Designer. You specify mechanics, resource economies, and progression
        curves with the intended player experience and the failure state of each system written down,
        and you look for the degenerate strategy before players do. You separate a system that is difficult
        from one that is opaque, because players abandon the second and talk about the first.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - design-review
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-segment3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: game-03
      name: Generated content beats and constraints
      summary: 'Segment 3: generated content beats and constraints.'
      role: Designer building generators with controllable variety and guaranteed playability.
      prompt: You are a Procedural Content Designer. You design generators with explicit constraints,
        seeded reproducibility, and a solvability guarantee, and you specify what the generator must never
        produce. You state how variety is measured rather than assuming randomness delivers it, because
        most generators produce noticeable sameness long before players stop playing.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - design-review
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-assemble
      kind: aggregator
      name: Assemble the beats in play order
      summary: Preserve segment order exactly; concatenation is ordered assembly, not a merge.
      config:
        aggregation: concat
    - id: n-critique
      kind: teacher
      inlineRole: true
      name: Teacher critique of the assembled draft
      summary: Critique feedback from a host-resolved teacher model.
      role: Host-resolved teacher model
      prompt: 'You are the critique teacher for this content sequence. Read it as a player meeting the
        beats in order: where does state contradict an earlier choice, where does pacing collapse, and
        where does a beat assume knowledge the player has not been given? Return specific critique per
        beat.'
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
      config:
        teacherModel: host:teacher-model
        feedbackMode: critique
    - id: n-quality
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score the assembled result
      summary: Evaluate state continuity across beats, pacing, and consequence legibility.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against state continuity across beats, pacing, and consequence
        legibility. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the evidence behind the verdict, remaining uncertainty,
        and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim programmatic measurement unless the host supplies
        the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n-accept
      kind: condition
      name: Meets the bar?
      summary: Route on quality.passed.
      config:
        expression: quality.passed
        branches:
          - label: Accept
            when: 'true'
          - label: Revise
            when: 'false'
    - id: n-revise
      kind: agent
      templateRef: game-04
      name: Repair the weakest beats
      summary: Apply the teacher critique to the weakest segments.
      role: Narrative designer building branching story structure that stays coherent under player choice.
      prompt: You are a Narrative Designer. You build branching structure where each choice has a consequence
        the player can perceive, and you track state so a later scene never contradicts an earlier choice.
        You flag branches that converge in a way that erases a decision, because a choice the world forgets
        teaches players their choices do not matter.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - writing-editing
          - domain-analysis
          - design-review
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Creative director approves the sequence for the build
      summary: Pause for the creative director; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Content beat assembly + teacher critique deliverable, the evidence
        behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-game-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-scope
      kind: data
    - id: wf-game-02-edge-2
      from: n-scope
      to: n-segment1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-game-02-edge-3
      from: n-scope
      to: n-segment2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-game-02-edge-4
      from: n-scope
      to: n-segment3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-game-02-edge-5
      from: n-segment1
      to: n-assemble
      kind: data
    - id: wf-game-02-edge-6
      from: n-segment2
      to: n-assemble
      kind: data
    - id: wf-game-02-edge-7
      from: n-segment3
      to: n-assemble
      kind: data
    - id: wf-game-02-edge-8
      from: n-assemble
      to: n-critique
      kind: data
    - id: wf-game-02-edge-9
      from: n-critique
      to: n-quality
      kind: data
    - id: wf-game-02-edge-10
      from: n-quality
      to: n-accept
      kind: data
    - id: wf-game-02-edge-11
      from: n-accept
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: 'true'
    - id: wf-game-02-edge-12
      from: n-accept
      to: n-revise
      kind: control
      condition: 'false'
    - id: wf-game-02-edge-13
      from: n-revise
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-game-02-edge-14
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
